entries.2d6e54e983ae09d5: The company, its parent company ITOCHU Corporation, 36 subsidiaries and 25 equity-method affiliates form the group (as of March 31, 2026). ITOCHU Corporation holds 55.8% of the voting rights, and the company sells and purchases petroleum products and other items with ITOCHU Corporation. The number of employees is 5,193.
entries.336d430d2f5e6188: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥851,235 million, down 7.9% from the previous year. The company explains the main reason as decreases in selling prices accompanying the decline in petroleum product prices, among others. Revenue from external customers was ¥584,747 million for the Car Life Business, ¥117,331 million for the Industrial Business, ¥77,774 million for the Home Life Business and ¥71,383 million for the Electric Power and Utilities Business.
entries.4cd904a6037038bd: Net income attributable to the company's shareholders for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,058 million, down 6.1% from the previous year. The company states that it was able to achieve its plan for net income.

entries.538004bdfca79707: This business delivers energy that supports the foundations of industry and distribution to companies. It handles asphalt, marine fuel, import and export of petroleum products, terminal tank leasing, fuel cards for corporate customers, industrial gases, pressure testing of gas cylinders, AdBlue® (high-grade urea solution that renders diesel vehicle exhaust harmless), renewable fuels, GTL fuel, energy services, and brokerage of PCB collection and disposal. The principal affiliate is Itochu Kogyo Gas Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥117,331 million, down 12.8% year on year. The company cites a decline in selling prices following lower crude oil prices, and a decrease in sales volume due to a partial reduction in transactions with ocean-going vessels.
entries.5ae6e71cc3f5906c: A business that delivers LP gas, electricity and other energy to households. It handles sales of LP gas and city gas, auto gas, renewable energy, retail electricity for households, and an EC site for housing equipment. The main related companies are Itochu Enex Home Life Co., Ltd., Ecoa Co., Ltd., Eneaku Co., Ltd. and Japan Gas Energy Co., Ltd. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥77,774 million, a decrease of 5.5% from the previous year. The company cites lower selling prices than the previous year, due to a fall in LP gas import prices, as the reason. The number of directly sold customer households was approx. 568 thousand, a decrease of approx. 7 thousand from the end of the previous year.

entries.6d4f6af2d2c3d85a: This business serves drivers and handles sales of gasoline, kerosene, gas oil, heavy fuel oil and electricity, sales of automobiles, lifestyle and car-related products and services, maintenance contract services, and auto auctions. Principal affiliates are Enex Fleet Co., Ltd., Kyushu Energy Co., Ltd., Osaka Car Life Group Co., Ltd. and Nissan Osaka Sales Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥584,747 million, the largest of the four reportable segments, down 7.2% year on year. The company cites, among other reasons, that unit sales of new and used cars in its automobile dealership business fell below the previous fiscal year. The number of CS (abbreviation kept as used in the securities report) fell by 50 locations from the end of the previous fiscal year to 1,496 locations.

entries.dd82e1608d648f0b: This is a business related to the supply of electric power and heat. It provides power generation, electric power sales to corporate customers, renewable energy, self-consumption solar power generation systems, electricity retail for households, heat supply (a business that delivers chilled and hot water through piping from heat-source plants to multiple buildings), car rental, and surplus solar power purchase services. Its main affiliates are Enex Life Service Co., Ltd., Enex Denryoku Co., Ltd., Oji ITOCHU ENEX Electric Power Sales Co., Ltd., and Tokyo Toshi Service Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥71,383 million, down 8.0% year on year. The number of electricity retail customers was approximately 318,000, an increase of approximately 7,000 from the end of the previous fiscal year.
